comparison.fileMtime: a file call's answer (readProjectFile, statProjectFile, previewProjectFileRange) carries the file's mtimeMs, which the OS stamps when a staged attachment or a restore writes it: each side proves the answer equals its own file's mtime on disk right after the call (lib/phone-attachments-script.mjs `play` fails the run otherwise) and the answer holds { $fileMtime: true } in its place
comparison.heldWhole: a string over 64 KiB in an answer (limit.bin read whole, the 2 MiB thumbnail) is held as its length and sha256, on both sides
comparison.placeholders: values one world names by a value of its own are compared by their place (lib/phone-attachments-script.mjs `play`): a grant's random token as $grant<n> in the order first answered, a recovery record's random id as $record<n> in seeding order, an inspected record's revision (a digest over its manifest, which holds that id and the world's file identities) as $revision<n> in the order first answered. Params that reuse them are resolved to the world's own value before the call.
comparison.recoveryStore: the recovery store after the script is compared by entry name (record ids as $record<n>) and each payload's size and sha256; manifest.json and state.json by name only (they hold the record id and the world's file identities)

entry.notRun: the relay transport (encryption, admission) and the session service process: the host's transcript reads are the service's own stored-session reads (store-summary-reader.mjs readStoredSessionTranscript, the cold read and the attachmentHistory read session-views.mjs makes), since no window holds these conversations
entry.runs: executeRemoteFrame over createRemoteMethods (remote-methods.ts) with a real SessionHost (project registry, readAttachmentImage over the attachment store), createDesktopOperations (readLocalFileAbs, statLocalEntryAbs, projectRecoveryIn) and createSelectedFileGrants

notRecorded.pathDeadline: resolveLocalPaths's 15 s per-path deadline (remote-methods.ts:646-660) needs a path whose stat does not answer (a stalled network share), which this world cannot make; the adapter keeps the deadline and its sentence
notRecorded.worktreeRecovery: projectRecovery of a worktree that is no registered project (session-host.ts projectRecoveryDirectory's worktree branch) needs Node's worktree runtime, not loaded here

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

worldSetup.attachments: blobs written at <data>/prompt-attachments/sha256/<2>/<ref> (the layout both stores read)
worldSetup.conversations: two conversations saved with Node's saveSessionAsync (session/store.mjs); the files it wrote are the golden's sessionFiles, which the replay puts in the core's data dir before it starts
worldSetup.recovery: two interrupted workspace edits: beginProjectRecovery then releaseRecoveryDirectory of project-recovery-store.ts (b6f10295a's here, the identical file of this repository in the replay), on Date.now = FIXED_NOW_MS
